lavender.description: A fragrant Mediterranean herb with violet flowers and aromatic foliage.
lavender.medicalInfo: Lavender is widely celebrated in modern aromatherapy and herbal medicine. Rich in linalool and linalyl acetate, its essential oil is clinically proven to reduce anxiety, alleviate insomnia, calm the nervous system, and possess mild antiseptic properties for skin healing.

nephrolepis.description: A lush fern with arching fronds that adds soft woodland texture.
nephrolepis.medicalInfo: Nephrolepis (and related fern species) is utilized in traditional herbal remedies for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and diuretic properties. It is traditionally decocted to clear heat, detoxify the body, and soothe respiratory discomfort.

santolina.description: A compact silver-green shrub for aromatic borders and dry gardens.
santolina.medicalInfo: Santolina (commonly known as Cotton Lavender) has a rich history in traditional Mediterranean medicine. It is highly valued for its anthelmintic (anti-parasitic) properties, traditionally used to treat digestive disorders, and its essential oil possesses notable antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory qualities.

ficus_microcarpa.description: A tropical fig tree with glossy leaves and an elegant canopy.
ficus_microcarpa.medicalInfo: Ficus microcarpa has a long history in traditional medicine. Its aerial roots, bark, and leaves contain bioactive compounds used to clear heat, dispel dampness, reduce swelling, and alleviate pain.
